_comment: icraft #35 Cataclysm boss-only Tetra material display names (refight-to-repair set). tetra.material.<key>.name = full name shown in the workbench material slot; .prefix = the adjective Tetra prepends to the assembled item name (e.g. 'Ignitium Sword'). Without these, Tetra falls back to a raw Title-Cased key ('Cm ignitium').
tetra.material.cm_ignitium.name: Ignitium
tetra.material.cm_cursium.name: Cursium
tetra.material.cm_witherite.name: Witherite
tetra.material.cm_ender_guard.name: Guardian Alloy
